T: The story of a nobody who saved everybody.

S: The crew shares a croissant without Emmet

Split the croissants and spread the insides with mustard. Fill with the ham and most of the cheese. Brush the tops with butter, scatter over the rest of the cheese and bake at 180C until melted and crisp. Cut in half and serve warm.
Barry's plan for after work tonight

Toss the wings with the honey, soy, garlic and paprika. Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C, turning once, until sticky and dark. Stir the sour cream, mayo, chives and lemon juice together for the dip.

M: The Kragle is set for Taco Tuesday

Brown the mince and onion, then stir in the cumin, paprika and tomato paste with a splash of water and simmer until thick. Mix the tomatoes and coriander with a squeeze of lime for the salsa. Stir the sour cream with the zest and juice of the other lime. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with lettuce, beef, salsa, cheese and crema.
Giant sausages and Emmet left behind

Fry the onions slowly in half the butter until soft and golden. Grill the sausages, turning, until browned and cooked through. Split and butter the rolls. Tuck in the sausages and top with onions, sauce and mustard.
W: No rules in Cloud Cuckoo Land

Simmer the berries and sugar until saucy, then cool. Scoop the ice cream into 4 tall glasses and spoon over the berry sauce. Toast the marshmallows under a hot grill or with a kitchen torch and pile them on. Finish with sprinkles and a wafer.
K: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream and dust with cocoa.
